verdict: LOG-MODE SOAK REQUIRED BEFORE CONTEND — extraction-level evidence is clean but production-shaped
scope_honesty: This verdict covers the EXTRACTION level only: the v9-stance-quote prompt's quote emission and verification rates on the stance-probe battery (80 single-note extractions) and the ladder rung (26-note batched bench). Single-note batches are quote-easy mode: the model sees exactly one source note.

The preregistered replay of retained dream-run journals was amended out (spec amendment 3): v5-era journals carry no quotes, so a replay measures nothing. The production-shaped half of gate 4 is a live log-mode soak, which requires the v9 prompt deployed on a bench window — not yet run.
The 'contend' default is therefore NOT proposed. span_gate ships 'off'.

ladder_quote_time_cost.note: quote emission costs ~10s (~20%) extract time on the 26-note ladder batch; claims count and both deterministic metrics identical (16 claims, gold_recoverable 1.0, stale_leak 0.0, both replicates, cache_prompt off, reproducible q8_0 server)

next_step: deploy v9 prompt on a bench/live window with span_gate='log'; review span_flagged reasons histogram from dream-run tallies; only then propose 'contend'
